## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Shàngqīng Língbǎo Great Dharma (Recension I)*

by [王契真](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%A5%91%E7%9C%9F) (Wáng Qìzhēn) — Southern-Sòng ritualist

A 44-*juàn* **Southern-Sòng ritual manual** synthesizing Shàng qīng and Líng bǎo liturgies — the first of two Dào zàng recensions (see [KR5g0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5g/KR5g0032) for Jīn Yǔnzhōng's recension). Preserved as **DZ 1221** / CT 1221 (正一部).

**Dating.** Southern Sòng. Dynasty: 南宋.
